description: For every arithmetic formula \(A(\bar z,x)\) and every fixed finite tuple \(\bar p\in\mathbb N^k\), including the empty tuple, there is no equivalence \(\mathbb N\models A(\bar p,\overline{\ulcorner\sigma\urcorner})\leftrightarrow\mathbb N\models\sigma\) holding for every arithmetic sentence \(\sigma\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.DiagonalLemma.truth_undefinable_parameters {n : ℕ}
  (A : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin n ⊕ Unit)) (p : Fin n → ℕ) :
  ¬∀ (σ : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Sentence),
      A.Realize
          (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend p
            (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.sentenceCode
              Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.arithmeticSignature σ)) ↔
        ℕ ⊨ σ
